descriptions.preferred: This small maple is probably my favorite among the variegated dissectums. Its delicate texture and interesting color changes make it a conversation piece. The basic color is light green, almost yellow green in the spring. It darkens as the season progresses. Entirely overlaid on the basic color is a profusion of minute dots, specks, or flecks of pale gold or cream. The leaf shape is so distinct and the color so difficult to describe that personal inspection is necessary. In the fall, the leaves attain a rich gold which holds very well. The bark of the twigs and branches is a silvery green with definite white striping or elongated flecking. The leaves are dissected entirely to the leaf base. Each of the seven lobes is delicately and deeply dissected almost to the midrib. In turn, each lobule is again toothed, sectums. It is compact and makes a well-rounded, cascading plant 2 m high and 3 m wide. Tall staking during early growth of the plant or high grafting on a standard is desirable. The plant will then cascade as it matures. The original plant is believed to belong to Joel Spingarn of Baldwin, New York. sources.title: 彗星 Acer Palmatum 'Filigree'
sources.description: 彗星是一款生长缓慢非常美丽的脉叶羽毛枫，叶裂很 深，叶型非常独特，非常适合小型花园或水景。 'Filigree' 春天的叶子呈浅黄绿色，略带奶油色，带有沿着叶脉 的白色点状斑点，秋天的颜色橙黄或者橙红色，需要 保护免受烈日照射，成年树高约 1 米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这种小型槭树大概是我在斑叶羽裂类中最喜欢的品种。 它质感细腻，叶色变化有趣，很适合作为引人谈论的观赏树。 基础叶色为浅绿色，春季几乎接近黄绿色，随后随着季节推进而逐渐加深。 在这一底色之上，密布着极细小的淡金色或乳白色点斑、斑点或细碎斑纹。 其叶形极具特色，而颜色又难以准确描述，因此最好亲自观察。 秋季叶片转为浓郁的金色，且观赏期保持较好。 小枝和枝条树皮呈银绿色，并带有明显的白色条纹或细长斑纹。 叶片深裂直达叶基。 7 个主裂片中的每一裂片又几乎深裂至中脉；随后每个小裂片边缘再次具锯齿，呈典型 sectum 状。 植株紧凑，形成圆整而下垂的树形，高约 2 米、宽约 3 米。 幼年生长阶段宜设高支柱牵引，或高位嫁接于标准砧木上，成熟后便可形成优美的垂枝姿态。 原始植株据信属于纽约州 Baldwin 的 Joel Spingarn。 那是他偶然购得的一株年轻绿色羽裂型植株，后来表现出这些特征。 Spingarn 将其命名为 ‘Filigree’；这是一个有效名称，而且非常贴切。 后来西部地区曾出现一两株类似植株，但命名并不规范。 它曾被称作 ‘Green Filigree’。 ‘Silver Lace’ 这一名称也曾被附会到它身上，但根据 Spingarn 的记录和历史，这属于误称。 ‘Filigree’ 是一个无论对景观设计者还是收藏者都极具价值的品种。 ‘Fior d'Arancio’ matsumurae -red。 该品种叶形和叶片大小与 ‘Wakehurst Pink’ 相似，但没有斑锦，且幼叶叶缘齿更粗壮、钩状感较弱。 叶片萌发时呈鲜亮的橙红色，随后发展为青铜红和铜红色。 在遮荫条件下容易转绿。 橙红色新叶与铜绿色老叶，甚至部分因遮荫而转绿的叶片形成对比，可产生迷人的多色效果。 大型叶片通常 7 裂，长 10–11 厘米、宽 11–12 厘米，幼叶阶段尤为醒目。 红铜色叶柄坚挺，长 4–7 厘米。 该品种形成直立、圆整的小乔木，高可达 5–6 米。 其起源于意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery。 该名称曾被误拼为 ‘Fior d'Arangio’。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Filigree' Reticulated Lace Leaf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: This is a very rare reticulated leaf form dissectum. The new leaves in spring are light green sometimes almost white with dark veins. A great plant for many parts of the world. Although very beautiful 'Filigree' is more of a collector plant in hotter climates as summers heat will really do a number on it around August, causing it to drop a large percentage of it's leaves. This is caused by heat and not lack of water. If you must try your luck with this plant in hotter climates please place in a cool shady spot. The growth habit is very pendulous and fall color is usually yellow to orange. 10 Year Size: Height: 3-6 Feet Width: 4-8 Feet
